errors.text_span: включват "Под 5 г.", "5-10 г." и "Над 5 г.", подредени в този ред
errors.evidence: The description states the categories are ordered "Под 5 г.", "5-10 г.", "Над 5 г.". However, the visual order on the vertical axis from top to bottom is "Над 5 г.", "5 – 10 г.", "Под 5 г.".
The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis scale ends at 84.4%. This value is the maximum data point shown, not the end of the axis itself, which is not labeled with a maximum value.
The description claims the horizontal axis has intervals of approximately 10%, but the axis in the image has no visible tick marks or interval labels.
The description uses the word "височината" (height) to describe the bars. For a horizontal bar chart, the more accurate term is "дължината" (length).
